page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance based on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor operating at 2.55 GHz. The system provides 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs across 32 physical cores with multithreading enabled. Memory capacity is 128.0 GB, which establishes a 1:2 compute-optimized ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated local storage and operates with a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Performance testing reflects strong multithreaded CPU capacity, placing in the top quartile for stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and PassMark encryption benchmarks. The AMD architecture includes AVX, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI instruction set extensions, but lacks AVX-512 and AMX instructions. Memory testing demonstrates top-tier bandwidth for cached small blocks, while large uncached memory throughput operates in the middle range. Geekbench benchmarks show strong scores in ray tracing and image processing, with moderate results in Clang software compilation and static web serving throughput.

The absence of local disks necessitates reliance on networked block storage for all operational data, which introduces external storage I/O considerations. The configuration offers efficient resource allocation for processing tasks where dedicated core density is prioritized over large per-core memory capacities. This instance fits highly parallel CPU-bound workloads, continuous integration pipelines, batch data transforms, cryptographic services, and backend application servers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by a 2.55 GHz AMD EPYC 7T83 processor on the x86_64 architecture. Managed via KVM, the configuration delivers 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores along with 128.0 GB of memory, maintaining a 2.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The instance includes no integrated local storage and features a 16 Gbps baseline network throughput. Benchmark results show strong performance across multithreaded CPU tests, including stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, hardware-assisted encryption, and small-model LLM inference. In contrast, uncached memory bandwidth, Clang compilation, and static web serving throughput score in the middle quartile. Because no onboard storage is provided, data persistence requires external network storage. This instance suits multi-threaded batch workloads, media rendering, cryptographic operations, and compute-dense backend microservices.
